note: Carlisle County KY parcels are only exposed through the Schneider qPublic PVA viewer, which returns HTTP 403 bot-check to automated access and offers no documented REST/download service. KYDGI's state PVA parcel services (kygisserver WGS84WM_Services) include only Webster County, not Carlisle. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches found no Carlisle parcel feature service; the clerk's maps are static PDFs; Regrid, Acres and Rockford are commercial.
